1FS3.claim: Bovine pancreatic RNase A, wild type, nothing bound.
1FS3.prov: X-ray at 1.4 A. The reference fold: three helices over a long curled sheet, four disulfides.
1FS3.title: CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF WILD-TYPE BOVINE PANCREATIC RIBONUCLEASE A

2AAS.claim: The same protein in solution, by NMR.
2AAS.prov: 32 deposited models; this is model 1, and it is not more real than model 12. The crystal fold and the solution fold agree.

1RUV.claim: Uridine vanadate in the active site — the transition state, held still.
1RUV.prov: X-ray at 1.25 A. Vanadium fakes the five-coordinate phosphorus RNA passes through, so the enzyme cannot finish the reaction and will not let go.
1RUV.title: RIBONUCLEASE A-URIDINE VANADATE COMPLEX: HIGH RESOLUTION RESOLUTION X-

1RNU.claim: RNase S: one backbone bond cut, and the protein still works.
1RNU.prov: Subtilisin cuts between residues 20 and 21. The 20-residue S-peptide stays bound to the S-protein and the pair is active. Residues 16-23 are unmodelled, so the gap drawn is wider than the cut.
1RNU.title: REFINEMENT OF THE CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF RIBONUCLEASE S. COMPARISON WITH

1A2W.claim: Two molecules, each folded around the other’s C-terminal strand.
1A2W.prov: Domain swapping: the same contacts as the monomer, made between chains instead of within one. The hinge is the loop around 112-115.
1A2W.title: CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF A 3D DOMAIN-SWAPPED DIMER OF BOVINE PANCREATIC

1F0V.claim: The other swap: the N-terminal helix traded instead.
1F0V.prov: Chains A and B of a deposition holding two dimers, with a CpG dinucleotide bound on chains M-P, which the bench does not draw. One protein, two different ways to come apart and re-fold as a pair.
1F0V.title: CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF AN RNASE A DIMER DISPLAYING A NEW TYPE OF 3D

1DFJ.claim: RNase A held by ribonuclease inhibitor, the protein that keeps it off your own RNA.
1DFJ.prov: A 456-residue leucine-rich horseshoe closing on a 124-residue enzyme. One of the tightest protein-protein complexes known.
1DFJ.title: RIBONUCLEASE INHIBITOR COMPLEXED WITH RIBONUCLEASE A
